QC Description: The value of euSurfaceWaterBodyCode must follow the syntax of WISE identifiers
Message: The value of euSurfaceWaterBodyCode must follow the syntax of WISE identifiers [V103]
Expression:
WITH Dataset AS (
    select  record_id,
            euSurfaceWaterBodyCode,
            (
            select  concat(
                    '^',
                    (
                     '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}' 
                    ),
                    '[0-9A-Z]{1}(([0-9A-Z]|\-(?![\-_])|_(?![\-_])){0,38}[0-9A-Z]{1}){0,1}$'
                )
            ) as regexp
    from    dataset_46598."swassociatedprotectedarea"
    where   coalesce(euSurfaceWaterBodyCode, '') <> ''
)
select  record_id,
        euSurfaceWaterBodyCode
from    Dataset
where   NOT REGEXP_COL_LIKE(euSurfaceWaterBodyCode, regexp)
